surfaces.name: eye-composer
surfaces.primaryTask: Choose a stock, recipe, and thesis; optionally record range, invalidation, and last-review context; save or amend monitoring intent deliberately.

surfaces.name: journal-composer
surfaces.primaryTask: Link an Eye, choose the recorded action, explain why, assess thesis validity and timing, then save or amend the human decision.

surfaces.name: recipe-builder
surfaces.primaryTask: Define monitoring purpose, supported logic, risk and review rules, inspect the result, then save a version deliberately.

surfaces.name: logic-registry
surfaces.primaryTask: Inspect raw field identifiers, human meaning, importance, declared source and coverage, and downstream processing.

surfaces.name: notification-confirmation
surfaces.primaryTask: Understand the saved preference change, then cancel or confirm disabling notification delivery.

stateEvidence.name: eye-blank-validation
stateEvidence.note: The first required Stock field and its adjacent actionable error are visible with composer context.

stateEvidence.name: eye-invalid-range
stateEvidence.note: Reversed optional range shows actionable errors and keeps the entered values.

stateEvidence.name: eye-edit
stateEvidence.note: Edit mode restores the exact authored thesis and invalidation rule.

stateEvidence.name: journal-required-validation
stateEvidence.note: The current required Eye context and adjacent error are visible; later action, thesis, and timing errors remain hidden.

stateEvidence.name: journal-amend
stateEvidence.note: Amend mode preserves the authored note and optional concern.

stateEvidence.name: recipe-purpose-validation
stateEvidence.note: The Purpose step names only the information required for that step.

stateEvidence.name: recipe-logic-validation
stateEvidence.note: The Logic step asks for at least one supported condition.

stateEvidence.name: recipe-final-review
stateEvidence.note: The final step reviews purpose, supported logic, risk notes, and review cadence before saving.

stateEvidence.name: recipe-version-context
stateEvidence.note: Saved Recipe detail exposes its version context and persisted monitoring intent.

stateEvidence.name: registry-field-detail
stateEvidence.note: The identifier, meaning, importance, expected source and coverage, and downstream links are visible together.

stateEvidence.name: registry-help
stateEvidence.note: Supported help explains how to read registry metadata without equating it with live provider health.

stateEvidence.name: notification-confirmation-cancel
stateEvidence.note: Confirmation presents the preference change and keeps cancel separate from the destructive action.

stateEvidence.name: notification-canceled
stateEvidence.note: Cancel returns to the still-enabled preference state without changing it.

stateEvidence.name: notification-save-error
stateEvidence.note: Injected technical exception retains localized safe copy, the unchanged Enabled preference, and retry/cancel actions.

stateEvidence.name: notification-save-success
stateEvidence.note: The confirmation closes only after the saved preference is Off.

stateEvidence.name: notification-pending
stateEvidence.note: The preference save remains pending until the delayed local storage acknowledgement returns in this capture fixture.
